reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 6 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Mavericks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 201 and 249 total points.

analyst.text: Minnesota have won four straight in the middle of an eight-game homestand, even without Anthony Edwards, who is out until late December after knee surgery. Dallas carry trade noise: Chris Mannix reports Kyrie Irving is "not on the Mavericks' timeline" and could be the deadline's biggest name, though others think Dallas keep him. Rumours like that can unsettle a team, but Irving has been producing. A slight lean to Minnesota's home rhythm.
